# Flick Migrate

> CLI tool to automatically convert Formr code to Flick.

## Installation

```shell
composer require --dev flickphp/migrate
```

## CLI Usage

```shell
# Single file
./vendor/bin/migrate-formr /path/to/file.php

# Entire directory (recursive)
./vendor/bin/migrate-formr /path/to/directory

# Preview without modifying
./vendor/bin/migrate-formr /path/to/file.php --dry-run

# Help
./vendor/bin/migrate-formr --help
```

## Options

--dry-run, -n    Preview changes without modifying files
--help, -h       Show help message
--version, -v    Show version number

## What Gets Converted

### Namespaces

```text
use Formr\Formr;     →  use Flick\Flick;
new Formr();         →  new Flick();
```

### Constructor

```text
new Formr('bootstrap')           →  new Flick(['views' => 'bootstrap'])
new Formr('bulma', 'hush')       →  new Flick(['views' => 'bulma', 'echo' => false])
```

### Form Methods

```text
create_form()        →  create()
form_open()          →  open()
form_close()         →  close()
form_open_multipart() → openMultipart()
```

### Input Methods

```text
input_text()         →  text()
input_email()        →  email()
input_password()     →  password()
input_checkbox()     →  checkbox()
input_radio()        →  radio()
input_select()       →  select()
input_textarea()     →  textarea()
input_file()         →  file()
input_upload()       →  file()
input_submit()       →  submit()
```

### Request Methods

```text
post('field', 'Label', 'rules')  →  request('field', 'rules')
get('field', 'Label', 'rules')   →  request('field', 'rules')
validate('...')                   →  request('...')
fastpost()                        →  request()
```

### Message Methods

```text
error_message()      →  errorMessage()
success_message()    →  successMessage()
warning_message()    →  warningMessage()
info_message()       →  infoMessage()
```

### Error Methods

```text
in_errors()          →  hasError()
add_to_errors()      →  addError()
error()              →  getError()
errors()             →  getErrors()
```

### Other Methods

```text
submit()             →  submitted()
unset_session()      →  destroySession()
get_ip_address()     →  getIp()
```

### Validation Rules

```text
required|email           →  required, email
min_length[5]            →  min:5
max_length[50]           →  max:50
exact_length[10]         →  exact:10
valid_email              →  email
valid_url                →  url
valid_ip                 →  ip
greater_than[0]          →  greaterThan:0
less_than[100]           →  lessThan:100
alpha_dash               →  alphaDash
matches[field]           →  matches:field
```

### Inline Validation Syntax

```php
$form->request('Name(required|min[2]), Email(valid_email)');
// Becomes:
$form->request('Name[required, min:2], Email[email]');
```

### Dropdown Names

These are dropdown *name* conversions applied inside `select()` arguments and
`'options' => '...'` values — NOT method-call renames. A bare `$form->state(...)`
method call is left unchanged.

```text
state         →  states
country       →  countries
months_alpha  →  months
cc_months     →  months2
cc_years      →  yearsPlus
```

### Prebuilt Forms

```text
$form->create_form('login')         →  $form->create('/login')
$form->create_form('short_contact') →  $form->create('/shortContact')
$form->create_form('signup')        →  $form->create('/registration')
```

## Items Flagged with TODO

The tool adds `// TODO: FLICK MIGRATION` comments for items needing manual attention:

### Pro-Required Features

```text
send_email()              →  $form->mail->send() (rewritten; needs Pro mail)
send_html_email()         →  $form->mail->send(..., ['html'=>...]) (rewritten; needs Pro mail)
recaptcha_*()             →  name kept, flagged with a Pro TODO (convert by hand)
upload($field)            →  $form->file($field) (core method; use $form->upload->image() for Pro processing)
```

### Methods with No Direct Equivalent

```text
button()                  →  Use HTML <button> directly
input_button()            →  Use HTML <button> directly
input_image()             →  Use HTML <input type="image"> directly
input_reset()             →  Use HTML <input type="reset"> directly
in_errors_if()            →  Use hasError() with conditional logic
heading()                 →  Use HTML heading tags directly
messages()                →  Manual handling required
```

### Properties with No Equivalent

```text
required = '*'            →  Use CSS to style required fields
inline_errors             →  Configure in view templates
custom_validation_messages →  Use per-field messages
method                    →  Flick handles differently
charset, doctype, minify  →  Not applicable
```

## Post-Migration Workflow

1. Run with --dry-run first to preview changes
2. Run without --dry-run to apply changes
3. Search for TODO comments: grep -r "TODO: FLICK MIGRATION" /path
4. Address each TODO manually
5. Install Flick Pro if needed (for mail, upload, reCAPTCHA)
6. Test all forms thoroughly
7. Remove package: composer remove flickphp/migrate

## CLI Output Example

```text
Formr to Flick Migration Tool
========================================

Scanning 5 PHP file(s)...

✓ controllers/UserController.php
  - Namespace changes: 2
  - Method renames: 15
  - Validation rule conversions: 8
  - TODO comments added: 2

========================================
Migration Summary
========================================

Files processed:          5
Files modified:           3
Namespace changes:        5
Method renames:           42
Validation conversions:   24
Property migrations:      3
TODO comments added:      6

Migration complete!
```

## Gotchas

1. Always use --dry-run first - Preview before modifying
2. Backup your code - Or use version control before running
3. TODOs require manual work - Not everything can be auto-converted
4. Pro features need license - Mail, upload, reCAPTCHA require flickphp/pro
5. Test thoroughly after migration - Automated conversion isn't perfect
6. Remove when done - This is a dev-only dependency
7. Custom Formr extensions not handled - Subclasses need manual migration
8. JavaScript references may need updates - Formr-specific attributes change

## Links

- Documentation: https://flickphp.com
